summary: Apex consolidation + archive move is incomplete at the gate/projection boundary: live index still claims 448 ADRs under docs/decisions, archive is unregistered for reachability, and path-resolving gates/manifests still require original docs/decisions/ADR-0xxx paths. ADR-0700/0703 do correctly state RE/CAS fail-closed.

findings.title: ADR index projections stale vs live 10-apex corpus
evidence: docs/ADR-INDEX.md: Total ADRs 448; links to decisions/ADR-0001-...; no ADR-0700..0709 rows
docs/machine-readable/decisions.json: total_adrs=448; path fields still decisions/ADR-0xxx under docs/decisions
Live tree: only docs/decisions/ADR-0700..0709-*.md remain; members under docs/adr-archive/
Gate: ci/facade/cross-artifact-agreement adr_index_projection_parity re-renders from docs/decisions/*.md and fails on missing_adr/phantom_adr/byte-parity
findings.second_order_effect: cloud-ci-cross-artifact-agreement will RED on merge for adr_index_projection_stale regardless of redirect map.
findings.fix: Regenerate docs/ADR-INDEX.md + docs/machine-readable/decisions.json from the post-move corpus (10 live apex + explicit archive policy). Decide whether archive is in/out of the index; if out, update oya-check-adr-index consumers and freeze baselines in the same PR.

findings.title: docs/adr-archive/ missing from reachability registry
evidence: specs/reachability-registry.json registers prefix docs/decisions/ only (ADR-0555 D3)
No docs/adr-archive/ registration anywhere under specs/
artifact-inventory-registry marks unregistered tracked paths unreachable; total-accounting treats new unreachable as baseline-block-on-new
findings.second_order_effect: Moving ~448 ADR files to an unregistered tree creates a large unreachable cohort and can fail total-accounting / inventory gates even if docs/decisions stays clean.
findings.fix: Add a reviewed reachability row for docs/adr-archive/ (anchor: disposition redirect map + apex supersession) OR keep archive outside tracked merge surface. Prefer registry row + OWNERS if files remain tracked.

findings.title: policy-deploy-parity baseline.adr ADR-0608 no longer resolves under docs/decisions
evidence: ci/facade/policy-deploy-parity/cedar-deploy-parity-policy.json baseline.adr = ADR-0608
baseline_adr_file_exists only scans docs/decisions for ADR-0608-*.md
ADR-0608 exists only at docs/adr-archive/ADR-0608-cedar-deploy-parity-gate.md; supersedes listed on ADR-0700
findings.second_order_effect: cedar deploy-parity gate fails closed: baseline.adr must resolve to existing docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-*.md.
findings.fix: Point baseline.adr at ADR-0700 (or retain a live stub/symlink policy). Prefer updating policy JSON baseline.adr to the live apex that supersedes 0608 and document grandfathering.

findings.title: Product/service manifests still cite dead docs/decisions/ADR-0xxx paths
evidence: oya/*/manifest.json and cloud/*/manifest.json still use "file": "docs/decisions/ADR-0xxx-..." (e.g. ADR-0234, ADR-0145, ADR-0342, feature-flags multi-ADR block, plugin-app-store ADR-0001...)
Those files are no longer under docs/decisions/
findings.second_order_effect: Any gate or catalog check that resolves manifest ADR file paths will fail; agent/tooling that opens manifest ADR links will 404.
findings.fix: Rewrite manifest ADR file refs to docs/adr-archive/... or live apex 070x via redirect map in the same PR; sample-validate all "file": "docs/decisions/ADR-0" under **/manifest.json is empty or only 070x.

findings.title: Registry and debt surfaces retain original ADR paths
evidence: registry/microservices.json: docs/decisions/ADR-0088-*, ADR-0086-*
registry/milestone-audit/index.json: docs/decisions/ADR-0139-*
registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml: multiple ADR-01xx/03xx under docs/decisions/
findings.second_order_effect: Second-order consumer breakage and false 'live law' citations after archive move.
findings.fix: Path-rewrite pass over registry/** for docs/decisions/ADR-0[0-6] to archive or apex; keep IDs if needed but correct filesystem paths.

findings.title: rg sample: many docs/decisions/ADR-0[0-6] path citations remain outside archive
evidence: Non-zero matches in packs (partially fixed to 070x), specs/microservices/*.json, specs/platform-architecture.json, docs/standards/*, cloud/*/adr-links.md, ci affected-set-policy, evidence/**, tools tests
Expected post-disposition residual should be 0 live-path refs (or only intentional archive docs/adr-archive/ + redirect map)
findings.second_order_effect: Citation rewrites incomplete; fails the PR's own success criterion and confuses agents about live authority.
findings.fix: Close-out rg gate: zero docs/decisions/ADR-0[0-6] outside tests/fixtures (or update fixtures). Prefer scripted rewrite using adr-redirect.v1.json.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md path rewrites collapse distinct historical ADRs onto ADR-0709
evidence: CLAUDE.md current_substrate_adrs lists ADR-0709 thrice with conflicting comments (folded into 0515 / historical)
historical_substrate_adrs and historical_vcs_ratchet_adrs all point at ADR-0709-general-live-apex.md
AGENTS.md paths mostly apex; still narrates ADR-0363/0515/0516 numbers without path (OK) but CLAUDE substrate lists are semantically wrong
findings.second_order_effect: Agent entry surface loses provenance discrimination; Chesterton risk — operators cannot tell which apex owns CI vs VCS history.
findings.fix: Restore distinct apex mapping: CI/admission→0700, monorepo→0701, fabric/protocol→0705, general/historical catch-all→0709 only where true. Keep archive paths for pure-history citations if needed.

findings.title: affected-set-policy still keys archived ADR-0637/0638 live paths
evidence: ci/facade/affected-target-set/affected-set-policy.json maps docs/adr-archive/ADR-0637-owned-deterministic-go-to-rust-port-engine.md and ADR-0638-*.md to k8s-program-docs gate
Those files live under docs/adr-archive/ now; apex is ADR-0704
findings.second_order_effect: Changing archived ports or apex will not select the intended gate; fan-in precision degrades.
findings.fix: Retarget policy keys to docs/decisions/ADR-0704-k8s-port-live-apex.md and/or docs/adr-archive/ADR-0637-*.md + ADR-0638-*.md.

findings.title: scm-facts ADR census P2/P3 second-order
evidence: registry/adr-census-epoch/control-plane.json active_epoch=P2
P2 is history-only fixed parent receipt; P3 selector root=docs/decisions but P3 not active
No adr-census-epoch-receipt.generated.json present in tree at review time
findings.second_order_effect: Immediate merge risk low while P2 remains active; flipping to P3 without regenerating receipt against the 10-apex tree will fail closed.
findings.fix: Keep P2 for this PR; if P3 activation is planned, regenerate epoch receipt + document expected source set (apex only vs apex+archive).

findings.title: Redirect map not wired into path-resolving gates
evidence: docs/decisions/_disposition/adr-redirect.v1.json exists with archive_path + live_id
policy-deploy-parity, adr index, graphql authorizing validation scan docs/decisions filenames only — none load redirect map
findings.second_order_effect: Contrarian: a redirect map that nothing enforces is documentation theater relative to fail-closed path resolvers.
findings.fix: Either teach critical resolvers optional redirect lookup or finish mechanical rewrites so resolvers never need it for merge-critical paths.

findings.title: Apex 0700 Decision claims RE/CAS activation fail-closed
evidence: docs/decisions/ADR-0700-ci-admission-live-apex.md Decision §4: Activation-sensitive items (warm CAS, RE workers) remain fail-closed until explicit go-gate
docs/decisions/ADR-0703-cas-cache-live-apex.md title + Decision §4 same fail-closed language
findings.second_order_effect: North-star anti-activation preserved in live apex text (does not by itself fix code gates).
findings.fix: None required for claim presence; ensure no other apex Decision softens this.

sampled_rg.result: non-zero residual outside docs/adr-archive (registry, manifests, specs, standards, ci policy keys, fixtures)
sampled_rg.target: 0 live residual (fixtures/tests may keep synthetic names)
